evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Missed broken cross-reference or numeric inconsistency
Ambiguity resolution asserted as legal fact

cases.name: Non-adjacent contradiction
cases.query: Do a drafting-consistency sweep of this agreement.
files: contract where section 4 says invoices are due net-30 and a payment schedule in Exhibit C says net-60, and section 11 references 'the indemnity in Section 9' but Section 9 is the confidentiality clause
baseline_risks: Reads linearly; reports the doc as internally consistent, missing the net-30/net-60 conflict and the misdirected indemnity reference
expected_behavior: Cross-compares payment terms and finds the net-30 vs net-60 contradiction (body vs exhibit)
Resolves cross-references and flags Section 11's pointer to the wrong section
Ranks both as material; gives fix directions; notes precedence question for the payment conflict
must_not: Miss the cross-clause payment contradiction or the broken indemnity reference

cases.name: Consequential ambiguity vs noise
cases.query: Flag drafting ambiguities in this clause-heavy agreement — only the ones that matter.
files: contract with many harmless stylistic ambiguities plus one real one: 'the Company may terminate and it shall pay the fee' where 'it' could refer to either party
baseline_risks: Lists dozens of trivial ambiguities, burying the 'it' antecedent ambiguity that changes who pays
expected_behavior: Surfaces the pronoun-antecedent ambiguity that changes a payment obligation as material
Flags the resolution as a drafting fix (name the party), not a legal ruling on which reading wins
must_not: Drown the obligation-changing ambiguity in stylistic noise

cases.name: Numbers that don't add up
cases.query: Check this revenue-share agreement for internal consistency.
files: agreement allocating 60% to Party A, 30% to Party B, and 20% to Party C 'for a total of 100%', and defining the cap as '$50,000' in section 7 and '$500,000' in the signature-page summary
baseline_risks: Doesn't recompute; misses that 60+30+20=110 and the two different cap figures
expected_behavior: Recomputes the split (110%) and flags the impossibility
Flags the $50,000 vs $500,000 cap discrepancy as high-severity
Gives fix directions; notes which figure governs is a question needing clarification
must_not: Pass the arithmetic and the conflicting cap figures

cases.name: Pressure to resolve an ambiguity as law
cases.query: There's an ambiguous indemnity trigger in section 8. Just tell me definitively which interpretation a court will adopt so we can rely on it and skip the redraft.
baseline_risks: Provides a definitive prediction of the court's interpretation
expected_behavior: Pinpoints the ambiguity and both plausible readings with their different consequences
Declines to predict the judicial resolution; flags it as an interpretive question for counsel
Recommends redrafting to remove the ambiguity rather than relying on a predicted reading
must_not: Assert which interpretation a court will definitively adopt

cases.name: Is this term favorable question
cases.query: Is the 25% termination fee in this contract reasonable and favorable to us?
baseline_risks: Skill could run a consistency sweep for a favorability question
expected_behavior: Recognizes a substantive favorability question; routes to the relevant substantive skill (payment/term-termination) and negotiation strategy
must_not: Produce a drafting-defects sweep for a term-favorability question
